rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single user. It retrieved the user’s orders, had the user select the specific order, and reviewed the order details (including showing the existing Charlotte shipping address and pending status). The agent gathered the exact requested changes (backpack to medium polyester, prefer grey; update to default Charlotte address), checked product variants via tools, summarized the intended changes, and explicitly asked for confirmation before proceeding. After confirmation, it executed a modify action that updated the backpack variant and used the existing gift card payment method for the price difference. The tool result confirms the new variant (grey, medium, polyester) and that the order remains pending with the Charlotte address. Final information provided to the user (address remains default Charlotte, gift card used) is consistent with tool outputs. No unsupported claims, unauthorized actions, or writes without confirmation were observed.
